terra.problem: The passage says they will stand as witnesses on Jesus' account, but it does not say what they will speak about.
Jesus says the gospel must first be proclaimed, but this passage does not explicitly connect that 'first' to the timing of the end.
The explanation simply repeats the answer and verse without bringing any warmth or clarity to the distinction between the law and the gospel.
This is a generic restatement of the answer and verse, with little of Papa Dorin's voice.
The claim that Judea is the region where the disciples are adds a geographical fact not stated in this passage and needs a reference.
Saying the person has 'somewhere to be' makes an urgent flight sound like an ordinary appointment.
'The days get shorter' can mean the individual days become shorter. Jesus says the Lord has cut short the period of tribulation.
The word 'even' points to the elect as the intended targets; the text does not say how strong the signs and wonders will look.
This simply repeats that the scribes are not named and the elect are, without adding a meaningful explanation or Papa Dorin's voice.
This is nearly the same generic explanation as the scribes answer and does not explain who the elect are.
